title: Multi-radius shape operator per BZK09 §3 ¶4-5
description: PATCH-96 implemented a SIMPLIFIED BZK09 §3: per-vertex shape operator from 1-ring (Meyer-style), single radius. BZK09 §3 ¶4-5 specifies multi-radius computation with windowed validity to avoid noise sensitivity: r0 = avg edge length, r1 = h target edge length, w = h/4 window; τ_min = 0.8 anisotropy threshold; K = 0.1/b_s mean-curvature threshold; pick valid S with smallest angle deviation in interval. Without this, our per-vertex shape operator may pick spurious anisotropy from noisy local geometry, leading to bad directional constraints.
definition-of-done: PrincipalDirectionField supports BZK09 §3 multi-radius shape operator: per point compute S_r at multiple geodesic radii r ∈ [r0, r1] with windowed validity check. Mean-curvature threshold K = 0.1/b_s applied alongside anisotropy τ_min.
testing-plan: 1) Add multi-radius shape operator computation to PrincipalDirectionField (or new class). 2) Implement windowed validity: a S_r is valid if all S in [r-w, r+w] have anisotropy and mean curvature above thresholds. 3) Pick most stable S among valid candidates (smallest angle deviation). 4) Verify constraint set on rocker-arm differs from PATCH-96 simplified version.
